name: Giant Frog
summary: A large frog that bites prey and swallows it whole.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The frog can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.text: The frog's {ref:glossary/long-jump} is up to 20 feet and its {ref:glossary/high-jump} is up to 10 feet with or without a running start.

actions.name: Bite
actions.onHit: If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc=11}).

actions.name: Swallow
actions.text:
The frog swallows a Small or smaller target it is grappling. While swallowed, the target isn't {ref:condition/grappled} but has the {ref:condition/blinded} and {ref:condition/restrained} conditions, and it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the frog. While swallowing the target, the frog can't use Bite, and if the frog dies, the swallowed target is no longer {ref:condition/restrained} and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the {ref:condition/prone} condition.

At the end of the frog's next turn, the swallowed target takes {dmg:2d4:acid}. If that damage doesn't kill it, the frog disgorges it, causing it to exit {ref:condition/prone}.
